title: Jim's books documenting government-funded anomaly research (AAWSAP/BAASS era)
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of Jim's books documenting government-funded anomaly research (AAWSAP/BAASS era), about 2008-2010s at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

plain: Tim Gallaudet, a retired US Navy admiral, told podcast host Jesse Michels about books by a man he calls Jim, including a follow-up he thinks is called "Future Visions and New Insights." Gallaudet says the books fully document research at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property long tied to reports of strange events, during the late 2000s and 2010s, when a Pentagon-funded study of advanced aerospace threats paid a private company to investigate there. He says they record many anomalies and many witnesses, and stresses that this was government-funded work, which would mean officials took the strange events seriously.
